name: packet.guru Agent Verifier API
description:
A self-check for automated clients. Call it and the answer describes the request you just made:
whether your Web Bot Auth signature verified, what your key directory publishes, the exact fault
and how to fix it, and plain facts about the address you came from.

No account, no key, no registration. The self-check is anonymous by design. An agent asking
whether it is configured correctly should not have to sign up to find out.

IMPORTANT: do not route the call through a proxy. The answer describes your request exactly as
it arrives, so anything that re-sends it on your behalf changes what the answer is about. A
request that did not arrive directly is reported as such in signals.transport.provenance
rather than guessing.
